alt: A deep terrace room with a rooflight slot, shown in five material schemes from charcoal and cream to saffron velvet and pale finishes, overlooking the sea.
text:
the light slots down one wall and lands on surfaces chosen to hold it.

a terrace furnishes itself through materials, autumn especially. not a view that happens to have furniture, but a room that happens to overlook the sea. five schemes—charcoal to saffron, cream to pale wood—each shifts the space into a different mood.

materials are what we live in. the view is what happens when you choose them well.
